#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Patch VP9 uncompressed headers of an IVF stream (profile 0 / 2, 4:2:0, one
frame per packet, constant frame size) to reach header states the libvpx
encoder never produces. The compressed header and tile data are left untouched,
so the result is still a valid stream that libvpx decodes (to different pixels).

usage: segment_hdrpatch.py IN.ivf OUT.ivf OP [OP...]
  abs:F[,F...]          set segmentation_abs_or_delta_update=1 on frames F
                        (each must code segmentation_update_data=1)
  lfdelta:F:R0,R1,R2,R3:M0,M1
                        on frame F force loop_filter_delta_update=1 and code
                        the 4 ref deltas and the 2 mode deltas ('x' = no update)
Frame numbers are 0-based packet indices.
"""
import struct
import sys


class Bits:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.d = data
        self.p = 0

    def f(self, n):
        v = 0
        for _ in range(n):
            v = (v << 1) | ((self.d[self.p >> 3] >> (7 - (self.p & 7))) & 1)
            self.p += 1
        return v


def parse(data, state):
    """Return a dict of bit positions for the uncompressed header of one frame."""
    b = Bits(data)
    pos = {}
    assert b.f(2) == 2
    profile = b.f(1) | (b.f(1) << 1)
    assert profile in (0, 2)
    assert b.f(1) == 0, "show_existing_frame not supported"
    key = b.f(1) == 0
    show = b.f(1)
    er = b.f(1)

    def color_config():
        if profile >= 2:
            b.f(1)
        cs = b.f(3)
        assert cs != 7
        b.f(1)

    def frame_size():
        state["w"] = b.f(16) + 1
        state["h"] = b.f(16) + 1

    def render_size():
        if b.f(1):
            b.f(32)

    if key:
        assert b.f(24) == 0x498342
        color_config()
        frame_size()
        render_size()
    else:
        intra_only = 0 if show else b.f(1)
        if not er:
            b.f(2)
        if intra_only:
            assert b.f(24) == 0x498342
            if profile > 0:
                color_config()
            b.f(8)
            frame_size()
            render_size()
        else:
            b.f(8)
            for _ in range(3):
                b.f(4)
            found = 0
            for _ in range(3):
                found = b.f(1)
                if found:
                    break
            if not found:
                frame_size()
            render_size()
            b.f(1)
            if not b.f(1):
                b.f(2)
    if not er:
        b.f(2)
    b.f(2)
    # loop filter
    b.f(9)
    pos["lf_delta_enabled"] = b.p
    if b.f(1):
        pos["lf_delta_update"] = b.p
        if b.f(1):
            for _ in range(6):
                if b.f(1):
                    b.f(7)
        pos["lf_delta_end"] = b.p
    # quant
    b.f(8)
    for _ in range(3):
        if b.f(1):
            b.f(5)
    # segmentation
    if b.f(1):
        if b.f(1):
            for _ in range(7):
                if b.f(1):
                    b.f(8)
            temporal = b.f(1)
            for _ in range(3):
                if temporal and b.f(1):
                    b.f(8)
        if b.f(1):
            pos["seg_abs"] = b.p
            b.f(1)
            for _ in range(8):
                for bits, signed in ((8, 1), (6, 1), (2, 0), (0, 0)):
                    if b.f(1):
                        b.f(bits + signed)
    # tile info
    sb_cols = (state["w"] + 63) // 64
    min_log2 = 0
    while (64 << min_log2) < sb_cols:
        min_log2 += 1
    max_log2 = 1
    while (sb_cols >> max_log2) >= 4:
        max_log2 += 1
    max_log2 -= 1
    n = min_log2
    while n < max_log2:
        if not b.f(1):
            break
        n += 1
    if b.f(1):
        b.f(1)
    b.f(16)
    pos["end"] = b.p
    return pos


def getbits(data, start, end):
    return [(data[i >> 3] >> (7 - (i & 7))) & 1 for i in range(start, end)]


def su(v, n):
    out = [(abs(v) >> (n - 1 - i)) & 1 for i in range(n)]
    return out + [1 if v < 0 else 0]


def main():
    src, dst, ops = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3:]
    raw = open(src, "rb").read()
    hdr, off, frames = raw[:32], 32, []
    while off < len(raw):
        size, = struct.unpack_from("<I", raw, off)
        frames.append((raw[off + 4:off + 12], bytearray(raw[off + 12:off + 12 + size])))
        off += 12 + size
    state = {}
    positions = []
    for _, data in frames:
        assert (data[-1] & 0xE0) != 0xC0, "superframes not supported"
        positions.append(parse(data, state))
    for op in ops:
        parts = op.split(":")
        if parts[0] == "abs":
            for f in map(int, parts[1].split(",")):
                p = positions[f]["seg_abs"]
                frames[f][1][p >> 3] |= 0x80 >> (p & 7)
        elif parts[0] == "lfdelta":
            f = int(parts[1])
            data, pos = frames[f][1], positions[f]
            vals = parts[2].split(",") + parts[3].split(",")
            assert len(vals) == 6
            new = [1]
            for v in vals:
                new += [0] if v == "x" else [1] + su(int(v), 6)
            bits = (getbits(data, 0, pos["lf_delta_update"]) + new +
                    getbits(data, pos["lf_delta_end"], pos["end"]))
            bits += [0] * (-len(bits) % 8)
            head = bytearray()
            for i in range(0, len(bits), 8):
                v = 0
                for x in bits[i:i + 8]:
                    v = (v << 1) | x
                head.append(v)
            frames[f] = (frames[f][0], head + data[(pos["end"] + 7) >> 3:])
            positions[f] = parse(frames[f][1], dict(state))
        else:
            raise SystemExit("unknown op " + op)
    with open(dst, "wb") as o:
        o.write(hdr)
        for meta, data in frames:
            o.write(struct.pack("<I", len(data)) + meta + data)


main()
